# Data Spec Labs

> Open-source tooling for Open Data Specifications. Home of the ODCS Java SDK (odcs-core).

## Products

- [ODCS Java SDK](https://data-spec-labs.github.io/odcs-java-sdk/): Java library to parse, write, validate, and build ODCS contracts
- [Home](https://data-spec-labs.github.io/): Data Spec Labs overview and validators

## External

- [GitHub: odcs-java-sdk](https://github.com/data-spec-labs/odcs-java-sdk)
- [Maven: odcs-core](https://mvnrepository.com/artifact/io.github.data-spec-labs/odcs-core)
